questions.question: Consider the following statements regarding the 2023 NATO Summit: I. It was held in Vilnius, Lithuania. II. Sweden was formally invited to become the 32nd member of the alliance. III. Members reaffirmed their commitment to spend at least 2% of their GDP on defence. Which of the statements given above are correct?

options.explanation: All three statements are correct.
All three statements are correct.
All three statements are correct.

The 2023 NATO Summit was indeed held in Vilnius, Lithuania. At the summit, Turkey removed its objections, clearing the way for Sweden to be formally invited as the 32nd member, though ratification processes were still ongoing. Members also reaffirmed and strengthened their commitment to spend at least 2% of their GDP on defence.
